text: You know what's up. My money.
It WAS twenty. You said you'd pay me back last Friday. You didn't. Now it's thirty.
Then I texted you. Twice. You left me on red both times. That's ten more. Now it's forty.
I just did. Red receipts cost money.
Broke? Dre. I deliver food for a living. Last night I dropped off large wings, cheese fries, and two milkshakes. Guess whose house it was.
Yours. You tipped me two dollars. With MY money.
Your cousin's name is Dre, gate code forty forty?
I don't need cash! You mean to tell me you don't got Cash App? Venmo? Zelle? Put it on a kite and fly it over my house! Tie it to a pigeon! I'll take it in quarters! I just want my money!
Oh, I know you do. Same job. Same payday. Same bank. That deposit hits at six A M Friday. I'll be in your driveway at five fifty-nine. Lawn chair. Snacks.
